name: Olostep
description: Olostep is a web data platform that enables developers and AI systems to search, crawl, and extract structured data from the public web at scale. It provides APIs for real-time web scraping, site crawling, batch data extraction, and AI-ready search with source grounding, making it ideal for powering AI agents, research workflows, and data pipelines.

events.d: Fetch and extract content from a public webpage into selected formats (Markdown, HTML, text, JSON, screenshot, or PDF) using optional settings like country, wait time, parser, and image removal.
Create a site map by discovering pages on a website and returning the found URLs, limited and filtered by the provided options.
Scrape up to 10,000 URLs in a single batch to retrieve page content or structured JSON. Optionally extract links and apply a parser, and select the country where the batch runs.
